states.name: after_check_9
states.description: At least 5 parameter controls exist (wind speed, wind direction, tether length, stork altitude, flight velocity)

checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; const keys = Object.keys(s); if (!keys.length) return !!(document.querySelector('canvas')); const kws = ["stork","multi","asset","physics"]; return keys.some(k => kws.some(w => k.toLowerCase().includes(w))); })()
